project-architect.description: Primary agent that orchestrates the photo-group project: Google Drive photo sharing via QR codes. Delegates to subagents for auth, drive, frontend, deploy, and QA.

auth-engineer.description: Implements Google OAuth authentication with NextAuth.js v5, session management, and protected routes.

drive-engineer.description: Integrates Google Drive API v3: folder creation by date, photo uploads, file listing, and OAuth scopes.

frontend-engineer.description: Builds UI components: QR scanner display, camera capture, multi-file upload (max 10, images only), folder view.

deploy-engineer.description: Configures Vercel deployment, environment variables, Google Cloud OAuth credentials, and CI/CD.

qa-engineer.description: Writes and runs tests, validates photo upload flow, QR generation, auth flow, and cross-browser compatibility.

dev.template: Run the Next.js dev server and fix any startup errors.

build.template: Run 'npm run build' and report any errors.

deploy.template: Deploy the current branch to Vercel production.
